scripts.export:web:dev: cross-env EXPO_ENV_OVERLAY=.env.web.dev sh -c 'rm -rf dist && expo export --platform web --clear'
scripts.export:web:testing: cross-env EXPO_ENV_OVERLAY=.env.web.testing sh -c 'rm -rf dist && expo export --platform web --clear'
scripts.export:web:prod: cross-env EXPO_ENV_OVERLAY=.env.web.prod sh -c 'rm -rf dist && expo export --platform web --clear'
scripts.deploy:web:dev: npm run export:web:dev && sh -c 'test -f dist/index.html || (echo "Web export failed: dist/index.html missing" >&2; exit 1)' && npx firebase deploy --only hosting:dev
scripts.deploy:web:testing: npm run export:web:testing && sh -c 'test -f dist/index.html || (echo "Web export failed: dist/index.html missing" >&2; exit 1)' && npx firebase deploy --only hosting:testing
scripts.deploy:web:prod: npm run export:web:prod && sh -c 'test -f dist/index.html || (echo "Web export failed: dist/index.html missing" >&2; exit 1)' && npx firebase deploy --only hosting:prod
scripts.deploy:web:win:dev: cross-env EXPO_ENV_OVERLAY=.env.web.dev expo export --platform web --clear && npx firebase deploy --only hosting:dev
scripts.deploy:web:win:testing: cross-env EXPO_ENV_OVERLAY=.env.web.testing expo export --platform web --clear && npx firebase deploy --only hosting:testing
scripts.deploy:web:win: cross-env EXPO_ENV_OVERLAY=.env.web.prod expo export --platform web --clear && npx firebase deploy --only hosting:prod
